content: Josepeme Baaŋa Lao YangongemooPolo Lamaiya

Josepe banya doo yuu range akali dupwana lenge kambu dokona poraiyuo lao karara ingya nayasa nakama pyao ralinyi nembo kamanda pena leya. Peyaminyipa, Namba Josepeŋe, lao angi yangongemoo polo lamaiya.
Nengya nengya pyao yuu ketae ee leyasa Isipi akalimi sepala kiŋi Peraona anda yuupi dokona lao peyami.
Josepeme yangonge dusipa kando namba Josepeŋe rakane mee kapa karengese? leya. Dopa leyamopa yangongedusipame pakame kumapala isingi warapo laa nayami.
Dopa piyami dokopabaa karo dokona reperepe pyuo epena leyasa peyami dokopa lao, Namba nakamana yangonge Josepe Isipi wambu kana nyuo ropo pyao maiyami kande dokoŋo, leya.
Dokona nakamba keta palamo lao mona nemba nalapape. Nakama kyawalete nyere lapala Anatumi namba dae wambo nyuo peeyapya, leya.
Mange doko ee kana lama iki lopo soo epo papeyamopa dee kingi paki ene sera dupwana eewara pyuo manjo pii narami ingiya.
Anatumi nakamana rara rembe naa nana lao dokona namba wambo rapa rapa pyuo nembeya. Namba dae peeyamo dokome nakama koo keta pisaraminyi lapala lete wai pyao nyere lao piya.
Dopa pilyamo dokona nakama suu pingi nyisasarami Anatumi lyakande. Peraona rakange inginyipyambwapala banya yuu kingi Isipi dake peparae namba jiyamopa iso karapu, leya.

Dakepa waiya lao rakane karamo dokona papala embena ikinyi Josepe kande dokome dopa pyuo lalamo larami. Anatumi namba Isipi wambu iso karare lapalaandake ingyuo waso kareyamo karoŋo. Namba keta waiya lao ipupi.
Epo dokopa yuu Gosene namba karo repeta palirami. Emba embena ikinyi wanepe embena sipisipi meme bulamakaope bange embena dupwa peparae lanyuo ipupi lalamo lamaipape.
Emba Gosene paliri ramo dokopa nambame nenge yano piramuli pyuo nyisaro. Ee kana kingi paki ene lopo seramo dokopa embena ree palu menape nenge yangya nana lao lapunu pilyamo doko lamaipape, leya.
Dee yangonge dupwa kando, Dakepa nakama peparae wane Benjamenemoo nakamana lenge angi dokome kandaminyipa pii langyuo leto, leya.
Rakane lamaiyuo, Namba iki yuu Isipi darena nambana ingyuo sipyamo karamo lao nakama kandami kandapi dopa pyuo lamaipala dokopa waiya lao mwua lapala lanyuoko dae ipupwape, leya.
Lapala yangonge Benjamene kupyuo rau pyapala ee andake leyasa Benjamenebaame banya pendeko dokona yukwaro karo eeko leyamopa
Josepe baame yangonge lapo dupwa nyinyi pipala ee lanyi pisiya dokopa yangonge dupwame baa role pyao pii leyami.
Josepe yangonge dupwa kala eparami lao Peraona anda dokona leyaminyi sepala banya yulu pingi mupwape baamoo rae maiyami.
Rae maipala Peraome Josepe kando lao, Embena yangonemoo lamaiyuo, Bange keyange dupwa nyuo mena kamelena retapala manjo yuu Kenane lambu pena lamainya, leya.
Nakamana rakane dee enda wanepe nyepala layo eparaminyipa yuu sukunya jeronopa yuu Isipinya amenge kapape doko nakama nao kararamiŋi epena, leya.
Yuu Isipi dakena mena oseme ipyuo papingi uliuli lapo nyuopao enda wanepe rakanemoo nyepala ipupwape, leya.
Nakamana yuu andape dupwa konda napala kala ipuwape. Isipi dokona ruu nao kararami lamailapape.
Isaraelena wane dupwame leyamuli pyuo piyami. Josepeme uliuli lapo nyuo maiyuo dee nenge katasa nao parami dupwa nyuo pipala maiya.
Baame nakama komau wakale wakale dupwa maiyamopape Benjamene dokona kana kulingi andete rema maiyuo dee komau kingi paki maiyuo piya.
Dee kamba rakange katasa nao epara dokona suu pyao Isipi nenge keyange wara pingi dupwana nyuo kenapalukusi byake akalisa nyuo dee nenge wakale nyuo donge akalisanya apu sakamyuo pena leya.
Dopa pyuo yangonge dupwa mapanyi nembapala karo panya kata nyiyami dokopa lao, Pao karo dokopa mona nemba nalapape, leya.
Nakamba Isipi yaki nyepala yuu Kenane rakange Jekope kareyamo dokona epeyami.
Josepe lete karapyande kandapala epelyamano. Baa Isipi liti peparaena mupwaingyuo karamo, leyaminyisa Jekopena kyawa sisingi kata papiyasa kinyi letaminyilao soo nyepa naya.
Dopa piyamopape nakamba Josepe pii leyamo dupwa makande pyuo lao dee uliuli Josepeme rakange nyela pena lao maiyamo dupwa kandapala baa mona pendakae lapala soo manji nyiya.
Dopa pipala lao, Kapakandelyo doko yakaŋa wane Josepe baa lete karalyamo doko kandapala kumaro paro kae, leya.
